This session runs on claude.ai. Its git committer is the platform's Claude, and the signature that makes branch commits Verified belongs to that committer, so leave the committer alone. Commits still need the user as author, set once per clone from the GitHub connector: call `get_me` (`mcp__github__get_me`), then run `holyagent vcs identity --name '<name>' --email "<id>+<login>@users.noreply.github.com"` with the name, id and login it returns (the login when the name is empty). Single-quote the name and write each single quote inside it as `'\''`: a name with `$`, a backtick or a double quote breaks double quotes. The command writes `author.name` and `author.email` to the clone's local git config, never to a file of the repository. `holyagent vcs commit` refuses a commit whose author is missing or looks like an agent's. The no-attribution rule covers the author and the commit text; the Claude committer is the one exception.
